gloss: total effort; full force; all-out power

definitions.gloss: total effort; full force; combined strength
definitions.explanation: The combined power, resources, or effort of an entire group or organization. Often used to describe mobilizing everything available to tackle a challenge.

examples.japanese: {総力|そうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げて→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: To tackle something with all-out effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総力|そうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結集|けっしゅう}→結集：13885_kesshuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧。
examples.english: We brought together the company's full resources to tackle the project.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{復旧|ふっきゅう}→復旧：07521_fukkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧、⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{総力|そうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げた→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}した→約束する：05643_yakusokusuru⟧。
examples.english: The government promised an all-out response toward the recovery of the disaster-stricken area.

notes:
The combined total of all available power, effort, or resources. Composed of ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧ (total/all) + {力|りょく} (power/force). Implies mobilizing everything an organization or group has.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総力|そうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to make an all-out effort
- {総力|そうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結集|けっしゅう}→結集：13885_kesshuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to rally all forces; to pool all resources
- {総力戦|そうりょくせん}: total war; all-out war
- {総力|そうりょく}⟦{特集|とくしゅう}→特集：13468_tokushuu⟧: comprehensive special feature (in media)

USAGE:
The expression {総力|そうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げて→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧ is the most common usage pattern, appearing in political speeches, corporate announcements, and news reports about major initiatives or crises. {総力戦|そうりょくせん} is a historical term used for wars involving the mobilization of an entire nation's resources, particularly World War I and II.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧: full effort, full strength — refers to one individual or entity's maximum effort
- ⟦{総動員|そうどういん}→総動員：19982_soudouin⟧: total mobilization — specifically about mobilizing personnel or resources
